description: This file defines the 'MacNodeModeCoordinator' class responsible for managing the lifecycle and communication of a node in the OpenClaw system on macOS. It handles connection setup, disconnection, configuration updates, and event forwarding between the app and a gateway server, utilizing async/await and various internal and external dependencies.

classes.name: MacNodeModeCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class managing the node's network session, configuration, and event handling in the macOS application.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the coordinator’s main loop to maintain the connection and handle state changes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the main loop and disconnects the session.

methods.name: setPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway stable ID and disconnects the session to apply changes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async loop that manages connection, configuration polling, and reconnection logic.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Determines the current capabilities of the node based on user settings and configuration.

methods.name: currentPermissions
methods.description: Fetches the current permission statuses asynchronously.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Builds a list of commands supported based on current capabilities.

methods.name: buildSessionBox
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket session box configured for secure WebSocket ('wss') connections.
